import sys; sys.path.insert(0, ".")
from langchain_chroma import Chroma
from langchain_core.documents import Document
from src.embeddings import HashEmbeddings
import tempfile, shutil

emb = HashEmbeddings()
tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
vs = Chroma(collection_name="t", embedding_function=emb, persist_directory=tmp)
vs.add_documents([
    Document(page_content="upload files to the object store after retrieval", metadata={"category": "mlops"}),
    Document(page_content="post retrieval logging is done to the mlops server", metadata={"category": "mlops"}),
    Document(page_content="security policy about access control", metadata={"category": "security"}),
])
r = vs.similarity_search_with_score("how to upload after retrieval", k=3, filter={"category": {"$eq": "mlops"}})
for d, s in r:
    print(round(s,4), "|", d.page_content[:60], "|", d.metadata)
r2 = vs.similarity_search_with_relevance_scores("how to upload after retrieval", k=3, filter={"category": {"$eq": "mlops"}})
print("relevance_scores:", [(round(s,4)) for _, s in r2])
shutil.rmtree(tmp)
EOF
